text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Inference queue growth on cluster-gpu-01. GPU pool utilization 100%, queue length increased from 12 -> 243 in last 5m, 5xx spike on /v1/generate. Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes (errors in cluster-autoscaler logs). Paging oncall.
oncall-amber: I'm on it. Can someone post cluster-autoscaler logs and recent ASG events? tagging @alex_choi @lee
alex_choi: looking now. grabbing logs from kube-system/cluster-autoscaler
alex_choi: kubectl -n kube-system logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler --since=20m
alex_choi: ```
I0926 18:23:11 cluster-autoscaler.go:867] ScaleUp: need 6 nodes for pending pods
E0926 18:23:12 nodegroups.go:342] launchtemplate: version mismatch for nodegroup gpu-pool-2, requested LT v7, actual v5
E0926 18:23:12 scale_up.go:512] Failed to launch instance: InvalidLaunchTemplateVersion
E0926 18:23:12 taint_controller.go:78] failed to apply taint: attachrole not propagated to node
``` 
lee: also seeing IAM errors in ASG events: "InstanceProfileNotFound: arn:aws:iam::12345:instance-profile/gpu-instance-profile-v2"
mike: customer-ops reports a handful of 503s from premium customers; tying to status page now.
customer-ops: approx 6 customers impacted, elevated support tickets incoming. ETA on mitigation?
oncall-amber: immediate mitigation options:
- quick: divert traffic away from GPU-backed route (route /v1/generate -> fwd to smaller model on non-gpu pool) to reduce burst.
- medium: manual scale of ASG with corrected launch template + attach proper instance profile
- longer: fix LT versioning in CI and rollout safer LT replacement
sre-pager: manual scale sounds fastest. Who can update ASG/eks nodegroup now?
alex_choi: I can attempt a manual ASG desired capacity bump to create nodes with the older working LT v5 as a short-term.
oncall-amber: do it. Also post the eksctl/cli commands you will run so we can audit.
alex_choi: Running: ``aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-asg-2 --desired-capacity 8 --region us-west-2``
alex_choi: also creating a temp nodegroup with correct profile as fallback: ``eksctl create nodegroup --cluster prod-cluster --name gpu-emergency-1 --node-type p4d.24xlarge --nodes 2 --node-ami auto --asg-access``
mike: heads up — creating extra GPUs will increase cost but customers are impacted, go ahead.
lee: while nodes are provisioning, taint propagation still failing on new joins. kubelet logs show: "failed to fetch iam role: NoSuchEntity". Looks like instance profile name changed in our LT v6 rollout.
oncall-amber: note for postmortem: LT v6 changed instance-profile to gpu-instance-profile-v2 but the ASG node template still referencing v1; reconcile.
kube-bot: Event stream for pods in inference-namespace (last 10m): "0/24 nodes available: 24 node(s) didn't match resource limits, 6 node(s) didn't have required taints"
alex_choi: manual ASG bump completed, waiting for EC2s. If these don't join, next step is to reattach correct instance profile via AWS console (I have permissions).
sre-pager: handing off to @lee for deeper IAM/launchtemplate rollback. I'm going offline in 30m but will monitor alerts.
lee: acknowledged, taking the cluster IAM lead. I'll run a dry check: ``aws ec2 describe-launch-template-versions --launch-template-id lt-0abcd --versions 5,6,7``
lee: result: v5: instance-profile gpu-instance-profile-v1, v6: gpu-instance-profile-v2 (deleted), v7: gpu-instance-profile-v2
lee: v6 references a deleted profile, which caused mismatch during rollout. We'll set ASG to use v5 until we re-provision the profile.
oncall-amber: please confirm rollback steps and post when nodes are Ready. Also start an Incident ticket with summary + customer impact.
customer-ops: filed INC-2024-9343, noted 6 customers degraded, added support contact list.
lee: patched ASG launch template pointer to v5: ``aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-asg-2 --launch-template "LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd,Version=5"``
alex_choi: new EC2s are launching and kubelet logs show join attempts. kube-system events show node registration.
kube-bot: New node events: "node/ip-10-0-5-12 registered, taint gpu=true:NoSchedule applied"; kubelet reporting role attached: gpu-instance-profile-v1
oncall-amber: monitoring queue length and 5xx rate
alex_choi: traffic diversion in place to non-gpu fallback for non-SLA customers. Premium traffic prioritized to new nodes.
mike: metrics: queue length down 243 -> 48 in 10m, 5xx count dropping
customer-ops: customer incident updates posted, some tickets auto-updated to status: degraded -> partial-restored
sre-pager: thanks team. Lee, can you open a PR to add CI checks preventing LT versions with missing profiles from being promoted?
lee: on it. adding a preflight that validates instance profile existence for new LT versions.
oncall-amber: final notes for handoff: Lee owning remediation and PR, Alex will validate nodes stable for 1h, SRE will follow up with cost review for emergency capacity. I'll update incident channel and postmortem template.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as P1: created incident.inc/INC-2024-9343. oncall-amber assigned.
oncall-amber: handing off to @lee for postmortem follow-up. If anything spikes, page me immediately.
lee: acknowledged — will update by EOD with root cause and timeline. :white_check_mark:
alex_choi: nodes stable, marking as monitoring.```
